sourceData.answer: To Open Something Up, To Throw Something Open, To Open Something To The Public
sourceData.mnemonic: When you <kanji>open</kanji> then <kanji>release</kanji>, say, a door, you're opening it up for everyone to come in. That's why it means <vocabulary>to open something up</vocabulary> or <vocabulary>to throw something open</vocabulary>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: This is a jukugo word, which usually means on'yomi readings from the kanji. If you know the readings of your kanji you'll know how to read this as well.
